scope: Each of the 29 production requests with one of nine trinkets of the application's Forever catalog the class may wear, alone in the first trinket slot or behind Ward of the Elements (12065) in the second: Prismcharm and Heart of the Scale (resistances), Golden Banana and Serenity Field (Spirit), Frozen Heart of the Mountain (Frost and Shadow spell damage), and the damage on-uses Smokey's Lighter, Everlook Pathcarver, Infernal Lasso and Linken's Boomerang, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust at 30 iterations.
generator: python3 validation/2026-10-04-trinkets-and-enchants/generate.py <scratch> 30 12065, keeping the variants whose name ends in one of 11905|13164|13171|15867|219345|249469|270226|272439|274759

criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2
